definition_i18n.zh-TW: 季節限定植物景（金針花、紅葉、芒草、花海…）。主判據是季節窗（seasonal_state：讀 data/v2/seasonal-calendar.json 的例年窗與今年實況），天氣僅保留基本可拍判據。今年實況由 AI 採集官方/半官方物候情報寫入，每筆必須帶來源 URL，網頁顯示時附上連結；無來源時僅顯示例年窗並標註「例年平均」。
definition_i18n.en: Season-limited plant scenes (daylily, red maple, silvergrass, flower fields...). The main criterion is the seasonal window (seasonal_state: read from data/v2/seasonal-calendar.json typical window and current-season status). Weather contributes only basic shootability. Current-season status is harvested by AI from official/semi-official phenology sources; every entry must carry a source URL shown on the page. Without a source, only the climatological typical window is shown, labeled as such.
definition_i18n.ja: 季節限定の植物景（金針花、紅葉、ススキ、花畑など）。主判断は季節窓（seasonal_state：data/v2/seasonal-calendar.json の例年窓と当年状況）。天気は基本の撮影可否のみ。当年状況はAIが公式・準公式のフェノロジー情報から収集し、必ず出典URLを添えて表示する。出典がない場合は例年平均のみ表示。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 季節窗判定：evaluation 取值為 window_open / window_closed（由 seasonal-calendar.json 的例年窗與今年實況窗對拍日曆得出；實況優先，兩者皆缺時誠實 not_evaluatable）。
rationale_i18n.en: Seasonal-window verdict: the evaluation value is window_open / window_closed (resolved by matching the calendar date against typical and current-season windows in seasonal-calendar.json; observed takes precedence, and with neither present the genre is honestly not_evaluatable).
rationale_i18n.ja: 季節窓判定：評価値は window_open/window_closed（seasonal-calendar.json の例年窓・当年窓と日付の突き合わせで決定。実況優先、どちらも欠ければ誠実に not_evaluatable）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 降雨 <0.2 mm/h：花田步道基本可拍（沿用已審門檻）；微雨對花景反而有水珠加分效果，不設下限。
rationale_i18n.en: Precipitation < 0.2 mm/h: basic shootability of flower fields and trails (approved threshold carried over); light drizzle adds droplet charm, so no lower bound is imposed.
rationale_i18n.ja: 降水<0.2mm/h。花畑・遊歩道の基本撮影可否。小雨は水滴として好条件のため下限は設けない。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 風 <5 m/s：花穗搖曳是構圖元素、強風破壞拍攝（金針花特寫/芒草逆光都禁強風）。5 為 provisional，可依主題差異化（芒草或許更寬）。
rationale_i18n.en: Wind < 5 m/s: sway is compositional up to a point, gale ruins the shot (daylily close-ups and backlit silvergrass both need calm). 5 is provisional and may be differentiated per plant (silvergrass might tolerate more).
rationale_i18n.ja: 風<5m/s。揺れは構図要素だが強風は撮影不能。5は暫定値で植物ごとの差別化も可。

owner_review: 2026-10-26 owner-approved as drafted. S1 reads the owner-maintained calendar (data/v2/seasonal-calendar.json; fail-closed: current_season requires source_url + retrieved_at, otherwise only the typical window is displayed); S2 precip <0.2 mm/h carries the reviewed generic shootability threshold; S3 wind <5 m/s is provisional — per-plant differentiation (e.g. silvergrass may tolerate more wind) is recorded as calibration debt. Owner maintains plant windows and current-season sources; AI harvest writes only the current_season field and never without a source. Expansion is now enabled.
